one_line: Insurance FNOL assistant that explains coverage and drafts a claim.
what_it_does: Browser-native crash reporting with policy-aware typed tools, evidence ledger, refusal handling, and human filing handoff.
leverage_rationale: Policy clauses and dynamic requirements become structured, auditable agent state rather than fragile UI interpretation.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show claim desk, policy/claim states, ledger/refusal UI, and browser agent context.
execution_rationale: A focused FNOL workflow is coherently presented with visible claim, coverage, and safety states, though end-to-end live filing is intentionally human-gated.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show multiple coherent claim-desk states and PATCH_REJECTED_LOCKED refusal outcome.
impact_rationale: Drivers after a crash have a concrete, high-stakes need for coverage-aware reporting; the product addresses both comprehension and data collection.
impact_evidence: FNOL use case; policy clauses and required answers; human-controlled final filing.
creativity_rationale: Distinctive safety-oriented insurance workflow with dynamic tool publication and adversarial note refusal.
creativity_evidence: Coverage-aware claim drafting; changing answer publishes/withdraws a tool; refusal ledger.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
advance_reason: Strong, differentiated high-stakes WebMCP use with credible product evidence.

one_line: Interactive chemistry bench for agent-assisted molecular discovery.
what_it_does: Periodic-table and molecular workspace combining PubChem grounding, 3D structures, hazard/property analysis, constraint solving, and traceable state.
leverage_rationale: Structured chemistry operations, live data grounding, async constraint jobs, and serialized state are substantially more reliable than visual browser driving.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show periodic table, 3D molecule viewer, property cards, and trace/tool views.
execution_rationale: Broad but coherent chemistry workflow with visible molecule construction and analysis surfaces; some backend claims are not directly observable.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show periodic-table input, molecular visualization, computed properties, and result views.
impact_rationale: Researchers and learners can reduce tedious cross-referencing while retaining transparent chemical properties and rejected-combination explanations.
impact_evidence: PubChem lookup/hazard classification; guided discovery workflow; beginner exploration.
creativity_rationale: Ambitious synthesis of interactive chemistry, agent orchestration, live grounding, and explainable constraint solving.
creativity_evidence: 23 typed tools; async ranking/cancellation; full state serialization; 2D/3D visualization.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
standouts: Live/offline degradation is a strength but not independently verified
advance_reason: High-leverage research interaction with unusually deep scope and visible chemistry results.

one_line: Construction review workspace dividing evidence gathering between agents and drawing judgment between humans.
what_it_does: Collaborative workspace for searching extracted construction-document evidence, navigating drawings, comparing submittals, and escalating uncertain findings.
leverage_rationale: Typed search, page/region navigation, and structured assistance requests fit agent strengths while preserving human drawing judgment.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show construction drawings alongside extracted tables and review workbench states.
execution_rationale: The seeded farmhouse project, known pass/fail packages, and visible document/table workflow indicate a coherent scoped demo.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show multi-document review, drawing views, structured tables, and product workspace.
impact_rationale: Construction professionals face costly document-review errors; the human-agent division directly targets a real workflow bottleneck.
impact_evidence: Open-source drawing set; seeded flawed door package and clean window package; assistance requests.
creativity_rationale: Thoughtful human-agent collaboration model rather than asking the agent to interpret drawings unreliably.
creativity_evidence: Agent searches/reconciles textual evidence; human reads drawings; structured handoff and return.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
standouts: Demo ships with fixed project data
advance_reason: Strong domain fit and credible human-in-the-loop construction review design.

one_line: Agent-ready medication search, comparison, cart, and simulated checkout.
what_it_does: Local-first prescription reference and simulated commerce app exposing exact medication, fulfillment, cart, delivery, and order-state operations.
leverage_rationale: Exact medication configurations and cart/fulfillment state are materially easier for agents to manipulate and compare through typed operations.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show drug explorer, exact-prescription comparison, request card, and shared comparison views.
execution_rationale: A complete simulated workflow is presented from search through comparison and checkout, with polished consistent screens.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show sequential medication discovery, comparison tables/cards, and prescription request state.
impact_rationale: Medication shoppers need understandable comparisons of form, strength, quantity, fulfillment, and cost; the app addresses that concretely.
impact_evidence: Structured medication facts; fictional pharmacy/delivery comparison; simulated checkout/order status.
creativity_rationale: A familiar commerce category gets a meaningful healthcare transparency and agent-state angle.
creativity_evidence: Exact-prescription comparison and shared view; agent-ready multi-step shopping workflow.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
standouts: Simulated commerce, not real prescription fulfillment
advance_reason: Good end-to-end scoped demo and clear structured-state value despite simulation.

one_line: Observability, replay, CI evaluation, and regression analysis for WebMCP apps.
what_it_does: Captures production tool traces, runs Chrome WebMCP evals in CI, and explores incidents, sessions, evidence, and generated cases.
leverage_rationale: Observability is built around structured tool traces and agent-run investigations; UI driving cannot provide comparable provenance and cross-release analysis.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show trace-like browser states, annotated runs, dashboard charts, and developer views.
execution_rationale: The dashboard, incident/session/release/case surfaces and described SDK/CLI form a coherent developer product; backend production claims are packaging-supported.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show multiple workflow states, analytics dashboard, replay cue, and technical panels.
impact_rationale: Teams shipping WebMCP agents need reproducible diagnosis and regression detection; this directly reduces debugging and evaluation cost.
impact_evidence: Production traces; CI evals; regressions across app/model/tool versions; case drafting and approval.
creativity_rationale: Strong infrastructure concept that turns agent behavior into inspectable, replayable engineering data.
creativity_evidence: SDK + CLI + dashboard; agent investigates incidents and drafts eval cases with approval.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
standouts: Production integrations not independently verified from frames
advance_reason: Clear platform-level leverage, credible workflow, and strong audience/problem fit.

one_line: Safety and recovery layer for agent actions with approval, receipts, and undo.
what_it_does: Protocol-neutral action engine validates, previews, policies, executes, receipts, and recovers agent actions in a headphone-shop demo.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP actions share the same policy-enforced semantic pipeline as UI actions, enabling reliable risk gating and recovery rather than blind clicks.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show headphone shop states and adjacent action/status surfaces; Devpost packaging identifies approval workflow.
execution_rationale: The shop workflow visibly supports product actions and the central approval concept; exact recovery breadth is claimed more than shown.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show repeated product page states and agent activity/status context.
impact_rationale: Users and developers need trustworthy automation around consequential actions; explicit order approval, receipts, and recovery address that directly.
impact_evidence: Discount/add/delivery automatic; order approval shows item, price, address, payment method.
creativity_rationale: Memorable interaction model for safe autonomy: risk-aware actions, receipts, diffs, and honest irreversibility.
creativity_evidence: Shared action engine; human approval before spending money; recovery path.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
standouts: Some recovery behavior not visible in supplied frames
advance_reason: Excellent safety interaction and coherent end-to-end commerce demonstration.

one_line: Discovers and composes WebMCP capabilities across independent providers.
what_it_does: Capability discovery layer that plans birthday-party services across venue, catering, cake, and newly appearing entertainment providers while adapting constraints.
leverage_rationale: Discovery and dynamic recomposition across independently exposed providers is precisely the structured capability problem general UI agents handle poorly.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show capability diagrams, provider/tool panels, composed results, and constraint violation state.
execution_rationale: The demo has a clear multi-provider plan, changing requirements, newly available provider, and validation outcome.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show repeated provider workflows, tool inspection, result states, and constraint rejection.
impact_rationale: Organizations and consumers benefit from goal-based composition across fragmented web services; the birthday demo makes the value concrete.
impact_evidence: Three providers composed, requirements changed, fourth provider added mid-task, budget maintained.
creativity_rationale: Ambitious agent-web interaction model with dynamic capability discovery and live plan repair.
creativity_evidence: Preserves valid work; recomposes invalid cake; discovers Pokémon provider without user naming it.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
standouts: Provider ecosystem is demonstrated through a curated scenario
advance_reason: One of the strongest WebMCP-native concepts: discovery, composition, adaptation, and constraints.

one_line: A drawing-and-guessing game where an AI agent is the other player.
what_it_does: Skribbl-like game exposing game state, canvas images, vector drawing strokes, guesses, chat, turns, scoring, and difficulty to an agent.
leverage_rationale: Native structured canvas reads and vector strokes make agent participation in a live drawing game feasible and precise, beyond generic UI driving.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show blank-to-progressive canvas strokes, game controls, and agent/game states.
execution_rationale: The visible sequential drawings and described turn/score modes indicate a complete small game, though model-backed live play varies by setup.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show incremental drawings and completed sketches in the game interface.
impact_rationale: It creates accessible social play and entertainment, with a clear human-agent interaction loop rather than a work automation task.
impact_evidence: Two minds/one canvas; alternating artist/guesser; chat, timed rounds, scoring, local demo.
creativity_rationale: Highly memorable use of WebMCP: the agent is a playful co-player that sees and draws on the same canvas.
creativity_evidence: Structured vector strokes; vision canvas requests; cooperative and competitive modes.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
standouts: Visual interpretation quality depends on external vision model
advance_reason: Distinctive, well-scoped human-agent play with clear product-motion evidence.

one_line: Multi-chain milestone settlement and service agreements for browser agents.
what_it_does: Creates agreements, checks balances, stages milestone funding/payouts, and supports human-approved crypto-to-bank settlement flows.
leverage_rationale: Typed financial tools plus milestone state and approval gates address reliable agent commerce and settlement beyond UI automation.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show agreement forms, dashboard/account states, transaction tables, and settlement workflow screens.
execution_rationale: The product surface is broad and visually coherent, but live blockchain/bank execution is not established by the still frames.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show configuration, wallet/dashboard, transaction, and status views; no confirmed real transfer.
impact_rationale: Agent-mediated commercial work needs escrow-like milestone protection and unified settlement rails; the intended audience and problem are concrete.
impact_evidence: Milestone agreements; multi-chain balances; human approval; NGN bank off-ramp claim.
creativity_rationale: Ambitious infrastructure combining agent contracts, milestone payments, multi-chain settlement, and fiat off-ramp.
creativity_evidence: Solana/Base/Stellar/Celo/BSC and bank payout scope; approval before transactions.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
red_flags: Claims of multi-chain and bank settlement exceed what frames prove
Financial execution is simulated or unverified
advance_reason: High-impact ambitious concept with strong visible UI, but eligibility and live execution need caution.

one_line: Location-aware shopping comparison across local, online, and second-hand offers.
what_it_does: Searches products near a chosen location, combines purchase channels, exposes dynamic facets, prices, verification state, and sorting to agents.
leverage_rationale: Structured location, dynamic product facets, and multi-source result state reduce the fragility of agent-led shopping research.
leverage_evidence: Frame sheets show search states, map/location interface, product listings, and desktop/mobile views.
execution_rationale: The search-to-results experience is clearly designed and packaged, though live multi-source retrieval depth is not fully visible.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show location maps, search controls, product cards/listings, and comparison views.
impact_rationale: Product research across stores, marketplaces, maps, and used listings is a common concrete need; verified-price handling improves trust.
impact_evidence: Local/online/second-hand channels; dynamic filters; verified vs unverified offers.
creativity_rationale: A useful synthesis of local discovery and agent shopping with nuanced dynamic filtering.
creativity_evidence: Product-specific facets and explicit hiding of unverified offers; total-price sorting.
usability_note: Clear task-oriented interface; workflow complexity is appropriate to the domain.
standouts: External source coverage and price freshness not independently verified
advance_reason: Practical shopping workflow with credible WebMCP value and good evidence of the core UI.
